stories.title: NOSS Competency Matrix Cross-Reference Validator
stories.description: Create a Python script that validates all L4/L5 learning outcomes reference and build upon corresponding L3 competencies. Maps outcome codes across levels to ensure vertical skill progression without orphaned prerequisites or missing foundational skills.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_competency_chain.py reads all 20 CoCu files from content/IT-020-*/*.md and extracts learning outcome codes from each level
Generates JSON report mapping each L3 outcome → L4 prerequisites → L5 advanced applications; flags unmapped outcomes with file:line references
CI/CD integration: exit code 0 if all L3→L4→L5 chains complete, exit code 1 if orphaned outcomes exist

stories.title: Bilingual Content Parity Checker
stories.description: Validate that English and Bahasa Malaysia sections have equivalent depth, technical accuracy, and structural completeness—not just word-for-word translations. Identify sections where one language is significantly shorter or contains different technical detail level.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/check_bilingual_parity.py compares English vs BM sections in all CoCu header tables and content sections
Reports word-count ratio (warn if >20% variance), paragraph structure alignment, and technical term consistency between languages
Generates HTML report with side-by-side comparison highlighting parity issues, saves to output/bilingual_parity_report.html

stories.title: Equipment Specification Currency Auditor
stories.description: Scan all hardware and software references in 20 CoCu files against 2025 market standards. Flag obsolete products, deprecated versions, and components no longer available. Suggest current-year replacements with vendor validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/audit_equipment_currency.py regex-searches CoCu files for model numbers (e.g., Intel i5-9400, Ubuntu 18.04) and cross-references against public hardware/software EOL databases
Creates SQLite database scripts/equipment_refs.db with columns: product_name, model, current_status (active/deprecated/eol), replacement_2025, last_checked_date
Generates CSV export output/equipment_currency_audit.csv with remediation recommendations per CoCu file

stories.title: Practical Exercise Difficulty Rating Tool
stories.description: Classify all practical exercise worksheets by Bloom's taxonomy cognitive level (Remember/Understand/Apply/Analyze/Evaluate/Create). Ensure exercises progress in difficulty through L3→L4→L5, supporting scaffolded learning.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/rate_exercise_difficulty.py reads all CoCu files and extracts practical exercises from each activity section
Analyzes exercise descriptions using NLP/keyword patterns to assign Bloom's level (1-6 scale); creates taxonomy classification JSON: {exercise_id, bloom_level, cocu_file, activity_name}
Generates HTML visualization showing difficulty progression per competency across L3/L4/L5; warns if L4 exercises are easier than L3 or L5 has no Create-level activities

stories.title: NOSS Compliance Checklist Generator
stories.description: Create an interactive HTML5 checklist validating 25+ NOSS requirements against all 20 CoCu files. Generates JSON report with pass/fail/warning status per requirement, enabling JPK submission readiness verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_compliance_checklist.py defines 25+ NOSS validation rules (bilingual headers present, contact hours match course, 30/70 K/P split, learning outcome format, etc.)
Runs all validations against content/IT-020-*/*.md files; produces JSON output/compliance_report.json with {requirement_id, status, affected_files, remediation_hint}
Generates interactive HTML output/compliance_checklist.html with traffic-light status (green/yellow/red), drill-down to file:line where issues found, PDF export capability

stories.title: Assessment Item Difficulty Analysis Tool
stories.description: Analyze all assessment questions in the item bank (created in earlier stories) calculating psychometric difficulty index, discrimination index, and distractibility quality. Identify weak items and suggest remediation.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/analyze_assessment_items.py reads assessment database/JSON and calculates: difficulty_index (% answering correctly), discrimination_index (top 27% vs bottom 27% performance), distractibility (quality of wrong answers)
Generates Excel report output/assessment_item_analysis.xlsx with columns: item_id, content_area, difficulty, discrimination, flag (acceptable/marginal/weak), remediation_suggestion
Identifies outlier items (difficulty <0.2 or >0.9) and suggests removal or revision; validates minimum 0.4 discrimination index for quality items

stories.title: Industry Job Mapping Validator
stories.description: Cross-reference all learning outcomes against ISCO-08 job classifications and real job postings from major employment sites. Ensure curriculum aligns with actual market skill demands and employer expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_industry_mapping.py loads ISCO-08 occupational hierarchy (data/isco08_codes.json) and maps each CoCu learning outcome to relevant job classification (e.g., IT System Administrator = ISCO 3511)
Fetches top 50 job postings per job classification from public API (e.g., job-board scraper) and extracts required skills; compares against CoCu outcomes

Generates JSON report output/industry_mapping.json showing {outcome_id, isco_code, industry_demand_frequency, skill_gap_analysis} with HTML dashboard showing alignment gaps and employer expectation mismatches

stories.title: Prerequisite Learning Path Validator
stories.description: Ensure every competency activity defines its prerequisites and that no learning outcomes are orphaned without foundational support. Validate linear progression and dependency chains across all 20 CoCu files.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_learning_paths.py parses all CoCu files extracting learning outcomes and explicit prerequisites from headers/descriptions

Builds directed acyclic graph (DAG) of outcome dependencies; identifies cycles (circular prerequisites), orphaned outcomes (no prerequisites defined), and dead-ends (terminal outcomes with no L4/L5 progression)
Generates JSON output/learning_paths.json mapping each outcome to prerequisites and dependent skills; produces SVG visualization (output/learning_paths.svg) showing prerequisite chains per CoCu

stories.title: Instructor Facilitation Time Budget Generator
stories.description: Calculate realistic instructor-led teaching time per activity based on exercise complexity, assessment requirements, and contact hour constraints. Generate timing budgets to help instructors plan delivery.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_facilitation_budgets.py analyzes all practical exercises (complexity rating), assessments (time per item), and knowledge delivery sections to estimate teaching time

Generates Excel report output/facilitation_time_budgets.xlsx with columns per activity: content_delivery_min, exercise_time_min, assessment_time_min, total_allocated_hours, variance_from_contact_hours
Compares budgets against contact hour allocations in CoCu headers (must sum to L3=1200, L4/L5 per COURSE); flags activities over-allocated or compressed beyond realistic delivery

stories.title: CoCu File Structure Audit Tool
stories.description: Automated scan of all 20 CoCu files to verify mandatory sections are present, content is not orphaned, formatting is consistent, and file structure matches gold standard (content/IT-020-3/01_cocu-1-computer-system-set-up.md).
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/audit_cocu_structure.py reads all 20 CoCu files and validates presence of mandatory sections: NOSS header table, Set-up context, Key terms/tools, Contact hour distribution, Hardware/Software descriptions, Common faults, References, Learning outcomes

Generates HTML report output/cocu_structure_audit.html listing each file with section presence checkmark, orphaned content blocks (text not in any section), formatting inconsistencies (heading levels, table structure)

CI/CD gate: exit code 0 if all files structurally valid, exit code 1 if missing sections found; includes line-number references for quick remediation (e.g., content/IT-020-3/05_cocu-5.md missing 'Common faults' section at line 245)
